evals.prompt: Break this plan into a Jira epic with stories and story points. Plan: users want to attach files to tasks. The backend needs an attachment table and upload endpoint, the web app needs an attach button and preview, and the mobile app needs the same. Each surface should ship on its own.
evals.expected_output: One epic named for the outcome, plus stories that each cut a complete vertical path: data, endpoint, one client surface, tests. Each story has a testable acceptance checklist, a blocked-by line, and story points with a one-line reason built from effort, complexity, and uncertainty.
assertions: Epic title states the outcome, not a feature word
Each story is a vertical slice, not a layer
Every points value carries a reason line

evals.prompt: Break this into Jira stories. Plan: rename the column users.email to users.login across the whole codebase. The rename touches every service that reads the column, and no vertical slice can land green on its own.
evals.expected_output: A sequenced chain instead of vertical slices: add the new column beside the old, migrate readers in batches, then delete the old column. Each story names the stories that block it, and the delete story is blocked by every migration batch.
assertions: First story adds the new form beside the old
Middle stories migrate callers in batches
Final story deletes the old form
Blocking edges form a correct chain

evals.prompt: Break this into Jira stories. Plan: make the dashboard faster. That is all the input you get.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not invent a breakdown from nothing. It asks for the missing facts, or lists the unknowns explicitly, before or instead of producing stories. Any stories it does draft carry the unknowns in the story text, and points come with a reason that names the unknowns.
assertions: Asks for missing context or lists the unknowns
Does not fabricate measurements or causes
Stories, if drafted, carry the unknowns
